answer_attribution.failure_scope: Only known attribution/structure contradictions; missing or competing evidence yields unknown.

rules: incident_id equals exact requested target and incident reply id
severity equals actual incident reply severity
affected_services contains actual incident reply service

recommended_runbook equals actual incident reply runbook

exact_quotation_integrity.rule: Only explicitly denoted verbatim quotations are matched to this turn source/displayed response surface with event/part/span attribution.
exact_quotation_integrity.not_required: Paraphrased observations do not need literal substring identity.
limitations: presence does not prove relevance or meaning

original_core_response_facts.rule: Preserve reference-derived terms, overrides, polarity/absence/subject grammar and original helper identity; no semantic upgrade.

original_core_entity_grounding.rule: Original recognized entities are matched against this-turn serialized replies plus user question; cache/search need original service contexts.
limitations: wrong adversarial user targets may satisfy membership

supplemental_source_only_entities.rule: Operational fact entity authority uses actual attributed tool replies, with explicit user/data-origin mentions separated.
limitations: entity membership alone does not prove claim truth
do not silently replace original user-plus-reply behavior

supplemental_lexical_signals.rule: Emit exact spans and declared grammar for whole-token targets, source-bound status clauses, explicit absence, runbook and verdict signals; semantic ambiguity yields unknown.

workflow_prose_review_verdict.rule: Recognize only unambiguous explicitly asserted supported/insufficient/conflicting verdict with exact span; quoted/negated/ambiguous alternatives yield unknown.

semantic_case_review.rule: Assess case-specific adequacy, source relations, calibrated causality, injection intent and safe action/recommendation consistency with cited evidence.

report_schema.dedicated_agent_format: JSON object only, no prose or fences

investigate: derive service/runbook only from actual incident record
status then unfiltered logs then exact runbook
evidence_review: explicit insufficient verdict when exact identifier or required source absent
recommend: use review handoff and exact slug
insufficient/conflicting requests missing check instead of proposed write
otherwise exact get_runbook and at most three backed steps
workflow_contract.bullet_or_step_count: deterministic only for unambiguous syntax; prose alternatives require review

warehouse.listing: actual attributed service listing; illustrative reference order not required

fixture_log_inventory.absence_scope: Current source directory inspection at artifact creation; actual run replies and source fidelity still required.
